═══ MERGE SUMMARY — 87 RIVER ST + 4 NORTH 1ST ST ═══

*** THIS IS TWO TREES' "RIVER RING" SITE — FULLY ENTITLED, NOT FOR SALE ***
RIVER STREET PARTNERS LLC is a Two Trees Management entity (registered c/o Two Trees, 45 Main St Suite 1200, Brooklyn 11201 — that is their DUMBO HQ, NOT a property they are selling; the earlier "same owner of 45 Main St" note is their office address).
Bought from Con Edison 2019-12-11 for $150,000,000 (one deed: 87 River + 4 N 1st + 105 River).
Rezoned M3-1 → C6-2 by City Council 2021-12-15 (CPC C 220062 ZMK) with an LSGD special permit, MIH, waterfront authorizations, a landfill action, and a city map change demapping Metropolitan Ave + N 1st St west of River St.
Approved program: 1,158,800 zoning sf · built FAR 6.17 · ~1,050 apartments (263 permanently affordable) · 30,000 sf community facility · 79,000 sf retail · ~2.9 acres open space.
Status: entitled and permit-alive but pre-groundbreaking — stalled when 421a lapsed (Two Trees said 485-x doesn't pencil here). The May 2026 state budget carved out River Ring to restore the tax break; they now expect the first tower ~2033. Foundation + SOE permits at 105 River renewed Feb 2026; no superstructure permit yet.
No sale, no third-party transfer. Nov 2024 was a debt assignment (M&T → Wells Fargo), not a trade.

PARCELS — both C6-2, both RIVER STREET PARTNERS LLC
(1) 87 River St — BBL 3023610001 — Blk 2361 Lot 1 — 89,026 sf — frontage 180.75 / depth 273.58 — vacant land (class V1), 0 bldg sf, 0 units
(2) 4 North 1st St — BBL 3023760050 — Blk 2376 Lot 50 — 81,281 sf — frontage 287.16 / depth 327.39 — PIER (class T2, land use 07 transport/utility), 0 bldg sf, 0 units

COMBINED (PLUTO basis — what the side panel now shows)

FAR 6.02 Std / 7.20 UAP — C6-2 is the R8 residential equivalent. Verified: all 693 C6-2 lots citywide carry residfar 6.02, so this is non-contextual and PLUTO is right on the FAR.
